edits.text: PARTIES; DEFINITIONS. This Share Purchase Agreement (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of [date] by and between [Seller legal name], a [jurisdiction and entity type] with its principal place of business at [address] (“Seller”), and Meridian Acquisitions LLC, a [jurisdiction] limited liability company with its principal place of business at [address] (“Buyer”). [Target legal name], a [jurisdiction and entity type] (the “Company”), joins this Agreement solely with respect to the provisions expressly applicable to it. “Shares” means [number and class of shares or other equity interests], constituting [percentage] of the issued and outstanding equity interests of the Company, as set out in Schedule 1. “Business Day” means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a day on which commercial banks are authorized or required to close in [location]. Schedules and exhibits form part of this Agreement.

1. SALE AND PURCHASE; PURCHASE PRICE. Subject to the terms of this Agreement, at Closing Seller shall sell, assign, transfer, and deliver the Shares to Buyer, free and clear of all liens other than restrictions imposed by applicable securities laws, and Buyer shall purchase the Shares. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares is USD [●] (the “Purchase Price”), subject to the adjustments, if any, expressly set out in Schedule 2. At Closing, Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the account designated in writing by Seller at least three Business Days before Closing. The parties shall specify in Schedule 2 any agreed adjustment methodology, including treatment of cash, indebtedness, transaction expenses, and working capital; absent an agreed provision in that Schedule, no post-Closing adjustment applies. Each party shall bear its own transaction expenses except as expressly stated in this Agreement.

2. CLOSING; CONDITIONS; DELIVERIES. The closing of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement (the “Closing”) shall take place remotely by exchange of executed documents and funds on the third Business Day after satisfaction or waiver of the conditions in this Section, or at such other time and place as the parties agree in writing, and in any event no later than [outside date] unless extended in writing. Each party’s obligation to close is conditioned on (a) no law or final, non-appealable order prohibiting the transaction; and (b) the other party’s material performance of its pre-Closing covenants and the accuracy in all material respects of its representations and warranties at Closing (subject to any expressly stated materiality standard). Buyer’s obligation is additionally conditioned on receipt of all required governmental and third-party consents listed on Schedule 3 and delivery of the items below. These conditions may be waived only in writing by the party entitled to their benefit. At Closing, Seller shall deliver duly executed instruments transferring the Shares, evidence of any required corporate approvals and consents, and customary resignations or other items expressly listed on Schedule 3. Buyer shall deliver the Purchase Price and its executed closing documents. The parties shall execute and deliver such further instruments as are reasonably necessary to give effect to the transfer. Risk and benefits associated with ownership of the Shares pass to Buyer at Closing.

3. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES. Seller represents and warrants to Buyer, as of the date of this Agreement and as of Closing (except representations expressly made as of another date), that: (a) Seller is duly organized, validly existing, and authorized to enter into and perform this Agreement; (b) execution and performance have been duly authorized and do not violate Seller’s organizational documents or, to Seller’s knowledge, any material agreement binding on Seller; (c) Seller owns the Shares beneficially and of record, has authority to transfer them, and will transfer them free and clear of liens created by Seller; and (d) the financial statements identified in Schedule 4 have been prepared in accordance with [specified accounting basis] consistently applied for the periods stated and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial condition of the Company as of the dates and for the periods covered, subject to the qualifications and exceptions set out in Schedule 4. Except for the express representations and warranties in this Agreement, neither Seller nor any other person makes any representation or warranty, express or implied. Buyer represents and warrants to Seller that Buyer is duly organized, authorized to enter into and perform this Agreement, and has funds available to pay the Purchase Price at Closing. The parties shall identify any additional Company-specific representations and disclosure schedules by written agreement; no unstated representation is created by this draft.

4. COVENANTS; INDEMNIFICATION; GENERAL. From signing until Closing, Seller shall operate the Company in the ordinary course, preserve its material assets and relationships, and not issue equity, declare distributions, incur material indebtedness, or dispose of material assets outside the ordinary course without Buyer’s written consent, not unreasonably withheld or delayed. Each party shall use reasonable efforts to obtain the consents for which it is responsible and shall keep confidential nonpublic information received in connection with the transaction, subject to disclosure required by law and customary adviser and financing-source disclosures. Subject to the limitations and procedures to be completed in Schedule 5, Seller shall indemnify Buyer and its officers, directors, and affiliates for direct losses finally determined to result from (a) breach of Seller’s express representations, warranties, or covenants in this Agreement, or (b) liabilities of the Company existing at Closing that were not disclosed in the agreed disclosure schedules, to the extent not reflected in any agreed Purchase Price adjustment. Buyer shall indemnify Seller for direct losses finally determined to result from Buyer’s breach of its express representations, warranties, or covenants. An indemnified party shall give reasonably prompt written notice describing the claim; delay relieves the indemnifying party only to the extent materially prejudiced. For third-party claims, the indemnifying party may assume the defense with competent counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified party, and no settlement imposing non-monetary relief or an admission on the indemnified party may be entered without its written consent. The parties shall specify in Schedule 5 the survival periods, thresholds, caps, exclusions, mitigation obligations, and treatment of insurance and tax benefits; those economic limitations remain open for negotiation and no limitation is implied by this draft. This Agreement is governed by the laws of [state/jurisdiction], without regard to conflicts rules. Notices shall be in writing and delivered to the addresses above (or updated by notice). This Agreement, including its schedules, is the entire agreement concerning its subject matter and may be amended only in a writing signed by the parties. No assignment is permitted without the other party’s written consent, except to a controlled affiliate that assumes the assigning party’s obligations. If any provision is unenforceable, the remainder remains effective. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature. [Add agreed dispute-resolution, termination, and specific-performance provisions.]
